title: Smokin' Buddha BBQ Dry Rub (Coffee & Kashmiri Variation)
headnote: DRAFT / UNTESTED. Reconstructed September 19, 2026 large-batch variation of Smokin' Buddha BBQ rub. The final direction swapped the original paprika/chili blend for Kashmiri, Hungarian, and ancho chilies; raised the garlic, lowered cayenne, and added finely ground medium-dark Brazilian Arabica coffee. Historical batch is industrial-scale, approximately 6.3 kg; portion down as needed.

ingredientGroups.title: Full reconstructed batch (approximately 6.3 kg)
items: 60 g medium-dark Brazilian Arabica coffee, finely ground like espresso

steps: Weigh all ingredients accurately into a very large food-safe mixing bowl or clean container.
Break up any clumps in the brown sugar, then whisk or tumble all dry ingredients thoroughly until completely uniform. Avoid breathing the fine pepper and chili dust.
Transfer to airtight jars, label the batch, and store in a cool, dark, dry location.
Apply directly to meat without a binder. Optionally allow 12–24 hours of refrigerated rest after seasoning before smoking.
reviewFlags: UNTESTED: no user feedback on this exact final reconstructed rub.

Historical total was described as 13 lb 6 oz (6,067 g), but the listed original weights plus final substitutions sum to approximately 6,326 g; ingredient weights are preserved and arithmetic discrepancy flagged.
Large batch: consider scaling before making, rather than assuming quantities are household-sized.
